dialog.content: I think I've introduced myself to everyone here. I can't find anyone else.
Before knowing what to do next, we heard the monitors turn on with a strange person speaking...
Hello, hello! Do you guys see me?
For everyone that wants to know who I am and why you all are brought here.
Please gather in the gymnasium ASAP. I'll be waiting...
Better question, who was that? It was just a silhouette we saw.
So someone is running the place I assume.
Should we really trust a silhouette, what if it's a trap?
To be completely honest we don't have much choice. We need more information.
Alright, we probably should go towards the gym
So there's a gym, it shouldn't be too far to walk to.
Hello! There I am again. I'm gonna explain the controls to the movement.
Use WASD to move around. The mouse to look around. And click with the mouse to interact!
You can also press TAB to show the map, which is useful if you wanna know where places are.
Good luck with your mystery adventure!
